_comment: What the live-price job fetches and when (India time). The cron in .github/workflows/live-prices.yml MUST match 'times' and 'days' (a test enforces this). Sized for GoldAPI's 300 requests/month: 8 runs x 1 metal x 26 days = 208. To add silver later, set metals to ["gold","silver"] and cut the run times so runs x metals x 26 stays under ~250. days: 0=Sun..6=Sat. graceMinutes: GitHub's free scheduler often runs jobs hours late, so the 'out of date' warning only appears when a slot older than this was never covered by a successful check.
